response.sql: WITH playlist_counts AS (SELECT p.PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Playlist AS p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack AS pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(track_count) AS tracks_per_playlist FROM playlist_counts), scored AS (SELECT pc.PlaylistId, pc.track_count, pc.track_count / NULLIF(a.tracks_per_playlist, 0) AS ratio FROM playlist_counts AS pc CROSS JOIN average_count AS a) SELECT PlaylistId, track_count, ratio FROM scored ORDER BY CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ratio DESC, PlaylistId LIMIT 10;
